sentinelValues.meaning: Last Restore Date -- info1 returns the date and info2 the time of the last automatic database restore.
Last Restore Status -- info1 returns the status number and info2 the status text of the last automatic database restore.

params.name: info1
params.description: Value 1 of the selector (Date if selector=0, status-number Integer if selector=2)

params.name: info2
params.description: Value 2 of the selector (Time if selector=0, status-text Text if selector=2)

overloads.semanticRole: Gets information about the last automatic database restore, with the concrete meaning/type of info1 and info2 selected by selector.

jointConstraints.rule: selector=0 (Last Restore Date) yields info1=Date, info2=Time; selector=2 (Last Restore Status) yields info1=Integer status number, info2=Text status description.

constraints: This command does not take manual (only automatic) database restores into account.
